name: diary-period-variants
description: Приёмочный прогон отборов «Дневника» (ошибки 0114e9c3 и 73fa3c3b): подсветка предопределённых наборов и применение периода с разными токенами/литералами и дополнительным условием. Даты НЕ зашиты: сид записей и ожидания вычисляются от текущего дня прогона (ошибка 42b7c183) — записи сеются вокруг сегодняшнего дня (сегодня, ±1, ±3 и предыдущая неделя), ожидаемые числа дней/подсветки выводятся из этого же плана. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.diary-period-73fa3c3b.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-42b7c183/out

steps.name: prepare-dates
steps.eval: (() => { const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const now = new Date(); const today = `${now.getFullYear()}-${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(now.getDate())}`; const utc = (day) => new Date(day + 'T00:00:00Z'); const add = (day, n) => new Date(utc(day).getTime() + n * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const fdw = 1; const todayIdx = (utc(today).getUTCDay() - (fdw % 7) + 7) % 7; const weekStart = add(today, -todayIdx); const weekDays = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => add(weekStart, i)); const plan = [[-3, 'День 1 '], [-1, 'День 3 '], [0, 'День С '], [1, 'День 5 '], [3, 'День 7 ']]; const seededWeek = plan.map(([o]) => weekDays[(todayIdx + o + 70) % 7]); const prevWeekDay = add(weekStart, -7); const nextWeekDay = add(weekStart, 7); const monthFirst = today.slice(0, 7) + '-01'; const lead = (utc(monthFirst).getUTCDay() - (fdw % 7) + 7) % 7; const gridStart = add(monthFirst, -lead); const gridEnd = add(gridStart, 41); const y = Number(today.slice(0, 4)); const m = Number(today.slice(5, 7)); const prevMonthFirst = m === 1 ? `${y - 1}-12-01` : `${y}-${pad(m - 1)}-01`; const prevMonthName = ['Январь', 'Февраль', 'Март', 'Апрель', 'Май', 'Июнь', 'Июль', 'Август', 'Сентябрь', 'Октябрь', 'Ноябрь', 'Декабрь'][Number(prevMonthFirst.slice(5, 7)) - 1]; const seed = [[prevWeekDay, 'День П ' + prevWeekDay], [nextWeekDay, 'После сегодня ' + nextWeekDay], [prevMonthFirst, prevMonthName + ' ' + prevMonthFirst]].concat(plan.map(([o, name]) => [weekDays[(todayIdx + o + 70) % 7], name + weekDays[(todayIdx + o + 70) % 7]])); const seeded = Array.from(new Set(seed.map(([day]) => day))); const thirtyFrom = add(today, -30); const inWindow = (day) => day >= thirtyFrom && day <= today; const thirtyDays = seeded.filter(inWindow).length; const thirtyStart = thirtyFrom > gridStart ? thirtyFrom : gridStart; const thirtySelected = Math.round((utc(today).getTime() - utc(thirtyStart).getTime()) / 86400000) + 1; const monthDays = Number(new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, 0)).getUTCDate()); const monthFeedDays = seeded.filter((day) => day.slice(0, 7) === today.slice(0, 7)).length; let literalFrom = null; for (let i = 0; i < 40 && literalFrom === null; i += 1) { const d0 = add(gridStart, i); const run = [d0, add(d0, 1), add(d0, 2)]; if (run.filter((day) => seeded.includes(day)).length === 2) literalFrom = d0; } if (literalFrom === null) throw new Error('не найден трёхдневный литеральный отрезок с двумя записями'); const literalDays = [literalFrom, add(literalFrom, 1), add(literalFrom, 2)]; window.__diaryDates = { today, weekStart, weekDays, prevWeekDay, nextWeekDay, prevMonthName, prevMonthFirst, seededWeek, seed, thirtyDays, thirtySelected, monthFeedDays, monthDays, literalFrom, literalTo: literalDays[2], literalDays, gridStart, gridEnd }; return { today, weekStart, prevWeekDay, nextWeekDay, prevMonthName, prevMonthFirst, thirtyDays, thirtySelected, monthFeedDays, monthDays, literalDays }; })()

steps.name: expected-week-state
steps.probe: ({ days: 5, records: 5, selected: 7, selectedDays: window.__diaryDates.weekDays, from: '$weekStart', to: '$weekEnd' })

steps.name: expected-month-state
steps.probe: ({ days: window.__diaryDates.monthFeedDays, selected: window.__diaryDates.monthDays, from: '$monthStart', to: '$monthEnd' })

steps.name: seed-records
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid = '{{networkId}}'; const seed = '{{thoughtId}}'; const mk = async (title, day) => { const t = new Date(day + 'T12:00:00').toISOString(); return window.etn.comments.create(nid, 'thought', seed, { kind: 'chronological', title, body_md: 'запись ' + day, valid_from: t, valid_to: t }); }; for (const [day, title] of window.__diaryDates.seed) { await mk(title, day); } return window.__diaryDates.seed.length; })()
